descriptions.text: I Take it All Back - Potion This will remove any effects of Scolopendra's Transmutation spell.

recap.text: Prepotente screams in Elle's face and sets a bubbling potion in front of Donut, tagged Give this to Princess Donut and Do NOT give to Tina. Carl tells her to wait for his word and to keep it from Signet, who would want it for Grimaldi. On the stage, Donut squeezes a paper bubble on Kiwi's neck, and the potion ball inside bursts. Kiwi stands as a naked ursine, and Big Tina's fourth roar comes out as Mom? Mommy?

beats.headline: A package for Donut
beats.text: Prepotente screams in Elle's face, announces that he is here to deliver a package, and puts a black, bubbling potion on the table in front of Donut. He received it in a benefactor box and cannot fathom why his sponsor would give him something intended for her. Then he leaves, and Bianca screeches outside. It is the second benefactor item given to somebody else for Donut. A tag hangs off the top like a label on a Christmas present: Give this to Princess Donut. Use when the time is right. Do NOT give to Tina. Carl tells Donut not to use it until he says so, and not to tell Signet, who would want it for Grimaldi.
beats.gist: Donut receives a black bubbling potion, tagged for her alone, and Carl tells her to hold it unused.

beats.headline: Bubbles on Kiwi
beats.text: Imogen snaps Carl's arm, Sir Ferdinand slams into her head and she backhands him away, and Carl heals himself. Kiwi, Donut calls from the stage, come here, lower your head. She grasps one of the paper bubbles on the back of Kiwi's neck with two paws and squeezes, and the potion ball hidden inside bursts just as Big Tina reappears on stage. The effect is instantaneous. Kiwi staggers and stands, no longer a dinosaur but an ursine, naked but for the remaining paper bubbles. The other raptors roar as one and their dots turn red. Tina roars, then roars again, and the third time it sounds almost like words. The fourth: Mom? Mommy?
beats.gist: Donut bursts a paper bubble on Kiwi's neck, and the dinosaur becomes an ursine.
